Below is a table showing the main datasets in the course. All of them are [available on Github](https://github.com/communitymaplab/geog4300_datascience){target="_blank"}, but you should also be able to right-click the link to download them locally.

It's _**HIGHLY**_ recommended that you save these to a single folder for all your course materials in a folder called "data." Most course scripts reference the Github repository to load these datasets, but this makes them easy to find should you not have access to that repo.


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(DT)

library(dplyr)

data <- read_csv(
  "data/course_data_full.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
    select(-`File name`)

datatable(
  data,
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "compact stripe hover",
  escape=FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    scrollX = TRUE
  )
)
```
